texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:InvalidAmount: Invalid amount format; amounts must be plain decimal strings with at most 18 decimal places.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:PendingCollectionCon: This business order already has a pending collection with a different channel, amount or currency. Cancel it first.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:AmountExceedsChannel: The amount exceeds the configured limit for this channel and currency.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:ChannelNotConfigured: The payment channel is not configured or available.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:StripeExpiryTooShort: Stripe Checkout sessions require at least 30 minutes of validity. Re-quote before paying.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:DebitConflict: This business order already has an unreversed debit with a different amount or currency.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:DepositNotOpen: Deposits are not open yet; charging is disabled until chain scanning has completed a first round.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:ChannelOutcomeUnknow: The channel call timed out or its outcome is unknown. The collection stays pending and will be reconciled by the background job.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:ChannelFailed: The channel rejected the payment request. The collection was marked as failed; you may retry.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:HostOnly: This feature is only available to host users.
texts.DisplayName:Collection.MaxAmount.WechatN: WeChat Native max amount per collection (CNY)
texts.Description:Collection.MaxAmount.WechatN: Empty means unlimited. CreateAsync rejects amounts above this limit.
texts.DisplayName:Collection.MaxAmount.AlipayP: Alipay precreate max amount per collection (CNY)
texts.Description:Collection.MaxAmount.AlipayP: Empty means unlimited. CreateAsync rejects amounts above this limit.
texts.DisplayName:Collection.MaxAmount.StripeC: Stripe Checkout max amount per collection (USD)
texts.Description:Collection.MaxAmount.StripeC: Empty means unlimited. CreateAsync rejects amounts above this limit.
texts.Description:Collection.Balance.DebitComm: The balance row lock is held until the outer order transaction commits; hot accounts fail by this timeout instead of queueing forever.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:TryAgain: Address derivation is in progress; please retry.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:MnemonicResetRefused: Deposit addresses or unfinished sweeps exist; resetting the mnemonic is refused.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:MasterKeyMissing: Master key is not configured (Collection:MasterKey); chain administration is unavailable.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:InvalidRpcUrl: Invalid RPC URL: must be an https address.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:InvalidVaultAddress: Invalid vault address: expect 0x + 40 hex chars.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:InvalidCap: Invalid node log result cap: expect >= 100.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:InvalidApiKey: Invalid chain API key shape: Ankr keys are 64 hex chars; Etherscan keys are 34 alphanumerics.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:ApiKeyExists: This chain API key already exists for the provider.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:BalanceStateConflict: Balance buckets are inconsistent with ledger rows (frozen shortfall); manual review required.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawActionConfli: Replay of the same withdrawal action with different amount/currency/user.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawHalted: Withdrawals are temporarily halted. Try again later.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawNotOwner: Only the owner can operate this withdrawal.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawInvalidAddre: Invalid recipient address (0x + 40 hex digits, all-zero rejected).
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawInvalidStatu: Withdrawal status changed; refresh and retry.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawRetryLimitRe: Withdrawal retry limit reached; manual handling required.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:HotWalletNotConfigur: Withdrawal hot wallet is not configured.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:HotWalletInsolvent: Hot wallet on-chain balance cannot cover this withdrawal.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawBreakerOpen: Hot wallet balance is below the circuit-breaker floor; approvals are blocked.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:HotWalletGasShort: Hot wallet BNB is insufficient for gas.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawPendingOutbo: Hot wallet has a pending outbound transaction; rebroadcast refused.
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:WithdrawRecentPayout: This address was paid recently; duplicate payout refused.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MinAmoun: Withdrawal requests below this gross amount are rejected.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.FeeRate: Decimal fraction of the gross amount; fee truncated to 8 decimals.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MaxDaily: Reject any single order above this amount (online MaxDailyWithdraw semantics); 0 or empty = unlimited.
Max valid withdrawals per UTC day.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.AutoAppr: Pending orders with gross amount <= this are auto-approved by the worker.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Halt: true = reject submissions and block all approvals.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Broadcas: Broadcasting orders older than this enter stuck-recovery.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MaxRetri: Beyond this RetryCount the order fails terminally.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.HotWalle: Approvals are blocked when hot-wallet USDT falls below this floor.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MinHotWa: Approvals are refused when hot-wallet BNB is below this.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Enabled: false = reject submissions and the broadcast worker sleeps; hot-changeable on the settings page.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Broadcas: Broadcast worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
Max withdrawal orders processed per broadcast round.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.AutoAppr: Max withdrawal orders auto-approved per round.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanEnabled: Scan worker scans blocks and creates deposit orders when on; sleeps when off. Hot-changeable.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepEnable: Sweep worker fuels/consolidates/credits when on; sleeps when off.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.HotWalletWa: Periodically scans hot-wallet token transfers and reconciles them against withdrawals; unmatched outflows raise anomalies.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanInterva: Scan worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepInterv: Sweep worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.HotWalletWa: Hot-wallet watch round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanBehindB: Alert when the cursor falls this far behind chain head.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepRoundL: Max amount activated per token per round; empty or 0 = unlimited.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.FuelBnbLimi: Max BNB per fueling transfer; beyond this the task fails for manual handling.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.GasBnbAlert: Alert when the gas address BNB falls below this.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.RetryCooldo: Retryable failures are re-queued after this cooldown.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.Rebroadcast: Sweep broadcasts without a receipt may be re-signed after this grace.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepStuckM: Alert when a sweep stays in Sweeping beyond this duration.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SkipRatioWi: Window for computing the skipped-deposit ratio.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SkipRatioTh: Alert when skipped+overflowed share exceeds this ratio (0-1).
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:DepositNotReleasable: Deposit order is not releasable (must be Confirmed with no sweep task).
